title: What do you do?
goal_hi: Apna kaam aur company simple English me batana.

forms.positive: I work at Edone Solutions as a web developer.
forms.negative: I don't work at a big company.
forms.question: Where do you work?

pattern.note_hi: Company ke pehle 'at', role ke pehle 'as'.

examples.en: I work at a startup as a designer.
examples.hi: Main ek startup me designer hoon.

examples.en: I work at an agency as a developer.
examples.hi: Main ek agency me developer hoon.

examples.en: She works at a bank as a manager.
examples.hi: Woh ek bank me manager hai.

examples.en: I work at Edone Solutions as a web developer.
examples.hi: Main Edone Solutions me web developer hoon.

examples.en: He works at a school as a teacher.
examples.hi: Woh ek school me teacher hai.

words.example_en: I have a client call today.

words.example_hi: Main clients ke liye websites banata hoon.

dialogue.title: New colleague
dialogue.context_hi: Office me naye colleague se pehli baar baat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, I'm Rahul. What do you do?
lines.hi: Hi, main Rahul. Aap kya karte ho?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hi Rahul, I'm Azim. I'm a web developer.
lines.hi: Hi Rahul, main Azim. Main web developer hoon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hi: Badhiya. Aap kahan kaam karte ho?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I work at Edone Solutions. We build websites for clients.
lines.hi: Main Edone Solutions me kaam karta hoon. Hum clients ke liye websites banate hain.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How long have you been there?
lines.hi: Aap wahan kitne samay se ho?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: About two years. I handle frontend projects and client meetings.
lines.hi: Lagbhag do saal. Main frontend projects aur client meetings handle karta hoon.

sound_focus.tip_hi: 'v' bolte waqt upper teeth lower lip ko chhue.

scenario.title_hi: Client poochta hai aap kya karte ho

turns.prompt_en: So, what do you do at Edone?
turns.hint_hi: Batao ki aap websites banate ho.
turns.model_en: I'm a web developer. I build websites for clients.

turns.prompt_en: How long have you been working there?
turns.hint_hi: Do saal se wahan kaam kar rahe ho.
turns.model_en: I've been working there for about two years.

turns.prompt_en: What kind of projects do you handle?
turns.hint_hi: Frontend aur client websites ka zikr karo.
turns.model_en: I handle frontend projects and client websites.

turns.prompt_en: Do you work with clients directly?
turns.hint_hi: Haan, meetings me client se baat karte ho.
turns.model_en: Yes, I speak with clients directly in meetings.

quiz.prompt: I work at Edone Solutions ___ a web developer.
